name: John B. Sherman House

status.note: The district's marker lists it among the lost houses of Prairie Avenue and gives no year.

summary: Built in 1874 for John B. Sherman, who ran the Union Stock Yards. Burnham and Root were the architects. Sherman's daughter Margaret married Daniel Burnham while it was going up.

notable.text: The architect married the owner's daughter. Margaret Sherman wed Daniel Burnham while the house was being built.
Sherman kept recommending his son-in-law's firm to his neighbors. Burnham and Root designed more houses on the street than any other architects.
